children: Ora Banda Mining gets a new bull in Macquarie after its share price tumbled to a nearly three-month low at the end of last week. Macquarie says Ora Banda's 1Q production, released Friday, missed its forecast by 17%. All-in sustaining costs were some 18% above what Macquarie had anticipated. It attributed the miss to a shutdown of the Davyhurst mill, wet weather affecting haulage from open pits and to the toll treatment processing plant. Macquarie cuts its FY27 EPS forecast by 14%. That drives a 13% reduction in its price target to A$1.30/share. Still, Macquarie upgrades Ora Banda's stock to outperform, from neutral, due to recent share-price weakness that included a 17% drop on the day of its 1Q report. Ora Banda is up 5.4% at A$1.17 today.
